about.title: About Me
description: Hi! Nice to meet you. Here's a bit about me: I hold a Master of Science in Computer Engineering with a focus on cybersecurity from Politecnico di Torino, obtained in 2023. During my academic journey I developed a PRNG based on chaotic maps, contributed to CyberChallenge.IT and led project teams in collaboration with Aruba S.p.A.
Currently, I work at Liquid Reply as a Consultant focused on LLM integration in the infrastructure workflow and LLM Agent development.

items.title: Consultant

items.title: Master of Science in Computer Engineering
items.description: During my Master of Science, I've competed in the CyberChallenge.IT, ranking top among 20 students in participating at the program in 2021. As a team leader at Challenge@PoliTo with Aruba S.p.A, me and my team developed password-less access methodologies using FIDO 2.0. I've participated in BIP CyberSec Talent Week and IEEE Eurocon 2023 competitions. My technical expertise includes IAM solutions using Keycloak and OPA, with automation on Kubernetes using CI/CD tools that I developed working on my thesis as an intern Liquid Reply. Beyond tech, I've dedicated 230+ hours as a teaching assistant, embodying IEEE-HKN principles as a member and young professional. I've organized events and led the Mu Nu Chapter at Politecnico, showcasing leadership, character, and attitude.

items.title: Team Leader at Challenge@PoliTo by Firms - Become Passwordless
items.description: As student for the Aruba Academy program, I developed and integrated mobile, desktop and web application access methodologies based on common passwordless access standards created by the FIDO Alliance and the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).

items.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
items.description: During my Bachelor of Science, I studied the basics of Computer Science, Physics and Telecommunications. Moreover, I worked on a short thesis project named “PRNGs based on Logistic Chaotic Maps and Generalized Lorentz Systems”.

items.title: White Hacker at CyberChallenge.IT
items.description: CyberChallenge.IT is the security training program for young talents between 16 and 24, the main Italian initiative to identify, attract, recruit and place the next generation of cybersecurity professionals.

items.title: Part-Time Teaching Assistant
items.description: Part-Time collaboration with Politecnico di Torino in assisting teaching activities of the Bachelor's first-year courses Computer Science (14BHDLZ) and Algorithms and Data Structures (03AAXOA).
